name: Republic of Artsakh (1991–2024)
description: The Armenian tricolour of red, blue and orange with a white stepped pattern entering from the fly, forming an arrow pointing toward the hoist.
history: Adopted on 2 June 1992 by the self-proclaimed Nagorno-Karabakh Republic, later styled the Republic of Artsakh, to a concept by Artur Mkrtchyan and design by Vahé Fattal; the stepped pattern represents Artsakh's separation from Armenia. After Azerbaijan's offensive of September 2023 the republic's president signed a decree dissolving it, and it ceased to exist on 1 January 2024.

features.role: stepped carpet pattern in the shape of an arrow
features.symbolism: Artsakh as a part of Armenia, separated from it, and the region's carpet-weaving tradition
